first.rationale: Activation messaging (memory_91) showed reliable week-one engagement lift and is directly responsive to the 6% QoQ activation decline. This is safer than promotional pricing (memory_73 showed retention damage) or referral_incentive (targets existing customers, not the current acquisition pressure). Onboarding simplification (memory_86) is complementary and also addresses the 4% completion decline. Verifying memory_86 and memory_91 will confirm their effect sizes and any boundary conditions before deployment. Enterprise_sales_assist (memory_44) is valuable but requires sales coordination and doesn't address the SMB price-pressure problem. Activation_messaging preserves long-term retention health while directly targeting the operational metrics in decline, and it scales efficiently to test in a standard experiment without requiring broad organizational change.
